title: Brain Training
subtitle: Focus and memory games for a regular brain-activity habit
disclaimer: This feature is not a medical device and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition.
worry: If you are worried about your memory, speak with a doctor or a local memory clinic.

training.title: Today's Training
training.dose: About three sessions a week is the plan — pick 5 or 20 minutes each time. Playing more is fine, but it earns nothing extra.
training.doneBody: Nice work. A day or two of rest before the next one is fine.
training.quitBody: Your records so far are saved. Because it wasn't finished, it doesn't count as a completed session.
training.stopBody: Everything so far is saved, but an unfinished session doesn't count as a completed one.

home.freePlayHint: Pick one game to practise. A round ends when your chances are used up.
home.howItWorks: Each puzzle is made fresh. Get it right and the next is a little harder; miss and it eases off. Levels show your skill at that game only — they are not a measure of memory or brain health.

settings.title: Brain Training settings
settings.timingHelp: Give timed games more time, or none at all. In the longer modes, running out of time doesn't cost a chance.
settings.soundHelp: A short sound when you get one right or wrong.
settings.hapticsHelp: A short vibration when you get one right or wrong. Same as the app-wide vibration setting.

memoryGrid.name: Flash Grid
memoryGrid.desc: Spatial memory practice: remember the cells that lit up, then tap them.

sequence.name: Sequence
sequence.desc: Order memory practice: tap the tiles in the order they flashed.

pairs.name: Match Pairs
pairs.desc: Flip two cards at a time to find matching pictures.

schulte.name: Number Hunt
schulte.desc: Find and tap the scattered numbers in order.

oddOneOut.name: Odd One Out
oddOneOut.desc: All the same but one. Spot it.

stroop.name: Color Word
stroop.desc: Pick the colour of the ink, not the word you read.

math.name: Quick Math
math.desc: Work it out and pick the answer.

series.name: Number Pattern
series.desc: Find the rule and pick the next number.

setMatch.name: Set Match
setMatch.desc: Find three cards whose features are each all the same or all different.

codeBreak.name: Code Break
codeBreak.desc: Use strikes (right digit and place) and balls (right digit, wrong place) to find the code.

makeNumber.name: Make the Number
makeNumber.desc: Use every number exactly once to make the target.

mazeRun.name: Maze Run
mazeRun.desc: Trace a path to the flag. Backtrack when you reach a dead end.

play.watchReverse: Watch — you will repeat it backwards
play.findOdd: Tap the one that is different
play.void: The screen stuttered — let's show that again
play.practiceHint: Practice — no chances or points at stake.
play.stopConfirm: Stop here? Your records so far are saved.

play.setBroken: Check {{attributes}}. Two alike and one different is not a set.

play.mazeRunGo: Trace a path to the flag
play.mazeRunKeys_one: Collect {{count}} keys in number order, then reach the flag
play.mazeRunKeys_other: Collect {{count}} keys in number order, then reach the flag

summary.improved: Your record in this game improved
summary.voided: The screen kept stuttering, so the round stopped

intro.practiceNote: The first few puzzles are practice. No chances or points are lost.
intro.welcomeBack: Welcome back. The first few questions will find your level again.
intro.firstPlacement: The first few questions find the right starting level.

rotation.title: The turned one
rotation.body: All the same picture. Tap the one turned a different way.

lookalike.title: Look-alikes
lookalike.body: The odd one now looks more like the rest.

nearTwin.title: Near twins
nearTwin.body: Only a tiny detail differs, like a smile or a clock hand.

glyphs.title: Tricky letters
glyphs.body: Letters that look alike, like b and d or O and Q.

colorNoise.title: Ignore the colours
colorNoise.body: Colours vary. Tap the one with a different shape.

mirror.title: The flipped one
mirror.body: All are turned; that is fine. Find the one flipped like a mirror.

absent.title: Maybe none
absent.body: Some boards have no different one. Check them all; if there is none, tap “None”.

glyphTwin.title: Near-identical characters
glyphTwin.body: Characters where just one stroke is slightly different.

moreNumbers.title: More numbers
moreNumbers.body: More numbers now, with more time to match.

moreCards.title: More cards
moreCards.body: More pairs now, and more time.

moreChoices.title: More choices
moreChoices.body: One more colour to choose from.

descending.title: Count down
descending.body: Tap from the biggest number down to 1.

reshuffle.title: Shuffle mode
reshuffle.body: Numbers move after every tap. The grid is one size smaller.

twoDigit.title: Two-digit numbers
twoDigit.body: The numbers have two digits now. Tap from the smallest up.

skipCount.title: Counting in steps
skipCount.body: Numbers go up by 2 or 3. Count the next one yourself.

alternate.title: Take turns
alternate.body: White and yellow boxed numbers in turn: white 1 → yellow 1 → white 2 → yellow 2 …

alternateOpposite.title: Opposite directions
alternateOpposite.body: White counts up from 1, yellow counts down from the top: white 1 → yellow 8 → white 2 → yellow 7 …

unmarked.title: No marks
unmarked.body: Found numbers stay as they are. Keep track yourself.

memory.title: Face-down memory
memory.body: Remember the positions. After the cards turn over, tap from 1 in order. A wrong card is briefly revealed.

fastShow.title: Shown faster
fastShow.body: The parts light up more briefly.

waves.title: Shown in parts
waves.body: The cells light up in 2–3 parts. Tap them all at the end.

reverse.title: Backwards
reverse.body: Tap the tiles in reverse, starting from the last one lit. From now on it is always reversed.

faster.title: Faster flashes
faster.body: The tiles now light up one after another more quickly. Keep up with the order.

descending.title: Going down
descending.body: Numbers can also shrink by the same amount each step.

geometric.title: Multiply
geometric.body: A rule where each number is the last one times the same number.

alternating.title: Up and down
alternating.body: A rule that adds, then subtracts, in turn.

growing.title: Growing steps
growing.body: A rule where the amount added grows each time.

fibonacci.title: The two before
fibonacci.body: A rule where each number is the sum of the two before it.

squares.title: Squares
squares.body: A rule built on numbers times themselves, sometimes plus or minus a little.

interleaved.title: Two in one
interleaved.body: Two patterns take turns. Read every other number.

doublePlus.title: Multiply and add
doublePlus.body: A rule that multiplies the last number, then adds or subtracts the same amount.

halving.title: Halving
halving.body: Rows that halve, or triple, appear.

mixedLines.title: Adding and multiplying lines
mixedLines.body: Read every other number: one line adds or subtracts, one multiplies.

growFactor.title: A growing multiplier
growFactor.body: The multiplier grows by one each time.

tribonacci.title: The three before
tribonacci.body: Add the three before to get the next.

threeLines.title: Three lines mixed
threeLines.body: Three rules take turns. Read every third number.

diffGrowing.title: Gaps that grow in steps
diffGrowing.body: How much the gap grows also grows.

diffLines.title: Gaps in two lines
diffLines.body: Read every other gap: each line has its own rule.

diffFib.title: Gaps from the two before
diffFib.body: Each gap is the two gaps before it added together.

cubes.title: Cubes
cubes.body: A rule built on a number times itself, times itself again, sometimes plus or minus a little.

missingTerm.title: Find the gap
missingTerm.body: The ? can now sit inside the row. Pick the number that fills it.

primes.title: Primes in order
primes.body: A rule of prime numbers — divisible only by 1 and themselves — one after another.

product.title: Multiply the two before
product.body: A rule where each number is the two before it multiplied together.

digitSum.title: Add its digits
digitSum.body: A rule where each number is the last one plus each of its digits.

diffPrimes.title: Prime gaps
diffPrimes.body: A rule where the gaps are prime numbers, one after another.

oneFamily.title: One theme
oneFamily.body: All pictures now come from one theme, like animals or fruit.

noPreview.title: No peek
noPreview.body: No first look at the cards now. Learn them as you flip.

triples.title: Find three
triples.body: Find 3 of the same. A wrong second card flips back.

word.title: Rule switch
word.body: “Word” sign: pick the colour the word names. “Colour” sign: pick the ink.

labelInk.title: Don't trust button colours
labelInk.body: The buttons are coloured too. Pick by the colour name written, not the button's colour.

switchOften.title: The rule switches more often
switchOften.body: Check the Colour / Word sign on the card every time.

frame.title: Ignore the frame
frame.body: The frame colour is never the answer.

div.title: Division
div.body: Sharing problems join. Answers always come out whole.

twoStep.title: Multiply and divide first
twoStep.body: With + or − next to × or ÷, do × and ÷ first: 6 + 4 × 7 = 6 + 28

missing.title: Fill the gap
missing.body: Pick the number that goes where the ? is.

color.title: Colour joins in
color.body: Colour joins shape and count. The three colours must also be all the same or all different.

fill.title: Fill joins in
fill.body: Look at solid, striped and outline too. Every feature must be all the same or all different.

none.title: There may be no set
none.body: If no three cards form a set, choose No set.

oneSet.title: Exactly one set
oneSet.body: Find the one set among similar cards.

three.title: Three-digit codes
three.body: Now find three digits. A strike is a right digit in place; a ball is a right digit elsewhere.

four.title: Four-digit codes
four.body: Find four digits using the clues from earlier guesses.

five.title: Five-digit codes
five.body: Now five digits. Deduce their positions as well as their values.

zero.title: Zero joins in
zero.body: The code may contain 0, even in the first position.

repeats.title: Digits may repeat
repeats.body: A digit can now appear more than once. Use the clues to work out how many times.

multiply.title: Multiplication joins in
multiply.body: You can use ×. Multiplication comes before addition and subtraction.

divide.title: Division joins in
divide.body: Try ÷ too. Do × and ÷ first, from left to right.

anyOrder.title: Choose the order
anyOrder.body: Tap the numbers in any order. Use every tile exactly once.

brackets.title: Use brackets
brackets.body: Work out brackets first. This target needs brackets.

target24.title: Make 24
target24.body: Use four numbers once each to make 24. Try a different order and brackets.

fraction.title: Fractions on the way
fraction.body: Intermediate results can be fractions. Only the final answer must match the target.

square.title: Squaring a number
square.body: Tap ² after a number to multiply it by itself: 3² = 9. Each tile can be squared once. Square first, then × and ÷, then + and −. A new operator starts with fewer numbers, then more are added.

winding.title: More forks
winding.body: Paths wind more. Retrace your path when you hit a dead end.

keys.title: Collect the keys first
keys.body: Collect numbered keys in order, then reach the flag. Backtracking keeps collected keys.

moreKeys.title: More keys
moreKeys.body: Collect all the keys in number order.

hidden.title: Remember the walls
hidden.body: Walls hide after a preview. Move from memory. Your remaining wall bumps are shown separately.

hiddenKeys.title: Keys from memory
hiddenKeys.body: In a hidden maze, collect keys in number order before reaching the flag.

rule.label: New rule
rule.unscored: This one doesn't count toward points or chances.

placement.label: Finding your start
placement.hint: A few questions to find the right level. No chances are used.

firstClear.title: First clear
firstClear.body: Played a round to the end.

cleanRound.title: Clean clear
cleanRound.body: Finished a round without losing a chance.

flawlessHunt.title: No wrong taps
flawlessHunt.body: Finished a 5×5 or bigger Number Hunt without a wrong tap.

span7.title: Seven to remember
span7.body: Remembered 7 in Sequence or Flash Grid.

firstSession.title: First session
firstSession.body: Finished Today's Training for the first time.

weekGoal.title: 3 this week
weekGoal.body: Did Today's Training 3 times in one week.

comeback.title: Back again
comeback.body: Came back after more than 2 weeks and finished a session.

relax.suggest: Your last rounds ended early. Want to turn on extra time?
